functionDeclarations.name: prepare_brief
functionDeclarations.description: Prepare an editable written brief from the buyer's words without searching, saving a run, or causing any external side effect. The buyer must review and confirm it in the interface.

functionDeclarations.name: get_property_details
functionDeclarations.description: Retrieve all governed public facts for one property currently visible to the buyer.

functionDeclarations.name: compare_properties
functionDeclarations.description: Compare two or three visible properties using the same governed fields. Preserve unavailable values instead of guessing.

functionDeclarations.name: get_payment_schedule
functionDeclarations.description: Retrieve an official published CRM payment schedule and installments for a visible property. Do not use purchase-scenario arithmetic as an official schedule.

functionDeclarations.name: calculate_purchase_scenario
functionDeclarations.description: Calculate a deterministic buyer scenario from visible assumptions. This is not a developer offer, mortgage approval, valuation, tax, or financial advice.

functionDeclarations.name: get_floor_plans
functionDeclarations.description: Retrieve published floor-plan media for one visible property.

functionDeclarations.name: get_property_documents
functionDeclarations.description: Retrieve published brochures, fact sheets, disclosures, floor-plan files, and payment documents for a visible property.

functionDeclarations.name: get_development_details
functionDeclarations.description: Retrieve governed developer, development, completion, and community facts for a visible property.

functionDeclarations.name: get_area_context
functionDeclarations.description: Retrieve a published Rama area guide for a Dubai community. Do not invent schools, commute times, yields, or market statistics.

functionDeclarations.name: prepare_advisor_handoff
functionDeclarations.description: Open a buyer consent panel for an advisor request. This tool never creates an inquiry or shares contact details by itself.
